reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar, which is derived from user-provided param. The doSomething method only replaces the last character of param with 'Z' if its length exceeds 1, but this does not sanitize or escape the entire string. Malicious input like '<script>alert("x")</script>' would become '<script>alert("x")Z' or remain unchanged if length ≤1, both of which can trigger XSS. No encoding/mitigation applies to the sink expression. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.
